keywords: Writ of Certiorari and Mandamus – Public procurement/tender process – Ground handling services at Chennai Airport – Unsuccessful bidder – Non-renewal of expired service contract – Cost reduction – Tender evaluation – Company\'s Procurement Manual – Absence of formal Evaluation Committee Report – Evaluations communicated by email – Board Paper – Lowest bidder selected – Collective decision argument – Discretionary writ jurisdiction – Interim relief – Public/operational consequences – Alternative remedy in damages – Continuation of lapsed contract – Notices refused – Application dismissed.
legistation: Constitution, Article 140. The principal procedural rules considered were Sri Lankan Air Lines\' Procurement Manual, particularly items 6.1, 6.2, 6.4 and 6.5; these are internal procurement rules rather than legislation.
